clip.hook: FNS: WINNING TEAMS HAVE ISSUES TOO
clip.notes: Successful teams hide internal problems. in_point 7.58, not 3.72: the clip was opening on "here's the other thing you guys have to understand about teams that are succeeding and" — a continuation marker referring to something the viewer never heard, which is rule 3 and the "as I was saying" opening. 7.58 starts on the contrast itself, "obviously for teams that are FAILING you're gonna assume there are problems / for teams that SUCCEED they had prior issues as well", which is the claim and is self-contained. Chat forced on at George's instruction despite 6% topicality. cam top pulled 344 -> 390: his own "17,082" viewer-count overlay sits at the top-left INSIDE the facecam, and the pane cropped it to a stray "82" in the corner. Detection agrees with the original rect at 74x, so the rect was right and the number is really in his cam; the only way out is vertical, since cropping left enough to clear it would cut his face.
